image_description: A close-up view of a bakery display window containing several large, elaborately decorated cakes. The cakes feature various designs including floral patterns, fruit toppings, and sculpted shapes. One cake in the foreground left has a brown crust-like appearance with colorful sprinkles or dried fruits. Other cakes are primarily white or light green with decorative elements. Reflections on the glass show some exterior elements and possibly interior lighting. A poster or sign is visible in the upper left corner behind the glass.
